title: Part 1.I — Container and Thing Contained
role: LOAD-BEARING UNIT (co-anchor with GM-00). Burke develops the ten dyadic ratios among the pentad terms, organizing them under the master spatial metaphor of container-and-thing-contained (scene contains act, scene contains agent, act contains agent under realist construal, etc.). The chapter works two paradigm literary cases at length — Ibsen's Enemy of the People (the scene-act ratio at work in a small-town public-health drama where the scene determines the act's moral coloration) and O'Neill's Mourning Becomes Electra (the scene-agent ratio where the New England setting calls forth the agent's tragic temperament). The two closing subsections, 'Ubiquity of the Ratios' and 'Range of All the Ratios', make Burke's strong claim that the ratios are not merely catalogued but actively generate motive-statements: every coherent ascription of motive is implicitly a claim about which ratio is operative. The chapter is the canonical source for the Phase 3 ratio-catalog deliverable.
